test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and N, are sitting in a row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order) .Only two people sit to the left of N. Only three people sit between N and H. Only one person sits between H and F. K sits to the immediate left of L. E is not an immediate neighbour of H. How many people sit to the left of G?
solution:
Given: Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and N, are sitting in a row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order) .

Only two people sit to the left of N.

Only three people sit between N and H.

Only one person sits between H and F.

K sits to the immediate left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1443074a12bd4d5eab5e7491c00ef2beaa0fcda4c662cc8a3b8fec4a3136400.png] 

E is not an immediate neighbour of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18e7c88833ce55ca82e31165acb5c88aaf737d5d2c6312251e37c92c15ca6142.png] 

And G sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4a077d62b35204a3fd14521cfccf791730289590d030d1df316eabe70416bc0.png] 

So, five people sit to the left of G.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
